name: P2SH
summary: Pay-to-Script-Hash (P2SH, BIP-16) introduced a new transaction type that allows the sender to pay to a hash of a script, rather than a public key. This enables multi-sig and complex spending conditions without burdening the sender with script details.
summaryZh: 支付到脚本哈希（P2SH，BIP-16）引入了一种新交易类型，允许发送方将资金支付给脚本哈希而非公钥。这使得多重签名和复杂花费条件成为可能，且无需发送方了解脚本细节。
